question: Under what temporal condition of practice is old age and death affirmed to be destroyed?
premises: A practice is indicated as done for one year.
The condition is when that practice has been performed.
Old age and death are said to be destroyed under that condition.
inference: When the practice has been performed for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The practice referred to is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
